notes.title: Full game Steam page live now!
notes.notes:
The Steam page for the full version of Victim Complex is now live! Head over to see a brand new trailer and sneak peaks at full game content!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3558530/Victim_Complex

As mentioned previously, anyone who paid any amount for Victim Complex: Part 1 is elligible for a free Steam Key to the full game, once they are available. Contact us now to be notified and sent one automatically once they are released, or check back periodically to learn more.

Thank you all for your support, and we've got some very exciting things planned to complete the story of Jack, The Complex, and all the residents therein...

notes.title: Feb 26 bug fix
notes.notes:
Fixes for bugs reported in the last few weeks, critically the code to the lockbox. Hopefully too many haven't been affected!

Stay tuned for an announcement about the full game steam page in the coming days!

notes.title: Coming soon: Full Game Page and price change
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Some changes are coming soon to the Steam presence of Victim Complex.

Originally, this page was going to contain the full story as it came out in parts. However, in working with a marketing agency, 5ive Bullet Games has decided to update this entry to be a Demo for the full game, which will launch with all content in Q4 2025.

Consequently, soon Victim Complex: Part 1 will be updated to be free-to-play, a process which can take up to a week or two.

Those who have paid any amount for this game up to this point can contact us directly for a free activation key for the new Steam page once it is public. Look for that announcement coming soon as well!

Thank you all for your support, and we cannot wait to share the full Victim Complex story with all of you and many more!

Best,
5ive Bullet Games

notes.title: 10/28 - v1.0.7
notes.notes: Small patch to update the behavior of spawned clues on reload and update the appearance of some of the specters ;)

notes.title: v1.0.4 10.25
notes.notes:
v1.0.4 fixes bugs found by a number of streamers over the last week, such as save data not loading correctly, particularly when starting a new game from main menu.

There is now a brightness setting in the options menu, which can increase the intensity of ambient and most directional lights up to 2x.

notes.title: v1.0.3 - Equipment and Lighting changes!
notes.notes:
Hello all! Several reviewers and streamers have had difficulty with the amount of light and the inability to use your flashlight along with other items, so this change aims to fix those issues.

1. Beams of moonlight have been added to several westward-facing rooms, illuminating sections of them more.
2. A directional ambient light now provides a slight amount of illumination throughout.
3. The Flashlight is no longer a "player item", it's now independent of other equipped items.
4. To counterbalance these changes, the flashlight beam is now narrower, leaving more of the periphery dark when other lights are not present.


A few other quality improvements from other feedback:

1. [Spoiler] ||Dead phone and charger will attempt to auto-combine when picked up||.
2. Item spawn point orientations/positions adjusted.

notes.title: Victim Complex in Beta Testing
notes.notes:
Victim Complex has entered closed beta testing! Which means we are well on track for releasing this Spoopy season! Get hyped!

If you are interested in beta testing or want further updates, please join the linked Discord server.

I am also looking for someone talented with video editing to assemble a launch trailer for the game as it currently stands. We could use some higher quality video to really get the hype train moving!
